# Explore White Desert

> Bedouin-run White Desert safari operator based in Bawiti, Bahariya Oasis, Egypt.
> Small-group overnight camping trips from Cairo into the White Desert (Sahara el Beyda),
> the Black Desert and Agabat Valley. Booking is direct on WhatsApp, no middlemen.

## Signature trip
- White Desert Safari, 2 days from Cairo with overnight desert camping: https://explorewhitedesert.github.io/white-desert-safari-2-days/
- Day 1: Cairo pickup, Bahariya Oasis, Black Desert, Crystal Mountain, Agabat Valley, sunset camp in the White Desert, Bedouin dinner, night under the stars.
- Day 2: sunrise, chalk formations (Mushroom Rock, Chicken Rock), back to Cairo by evening.
- Included: 4x4 transport from Cairo and back, private tents and camping equipment, all meals and drinks, Bedouin guide, national park entry tickets.
- Price: quoted per date and group size on WhatsApp; never listed on the site.

## Booking and contact
- WhatsApp (fastest, preferred): https://wa.me/201278220004 (+20 127 822 0004)
- Languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean site versions under /de/ /fr/ /it/ /es/ /pt/ /ru/ /ja/ /ko/.

## Practical facts
- Location: White Desert National Park, near Farafra and Bahariya oases, ~370 km southwest of Cairo, Egypt.
- Best season: October to April (mild days, cool nights).
- Group size: small groups; solo travelers and women traveling solo are common guests.
- No experience needed; the Bedouin team handles driving, camp and cooking.
- Reviews: 5.0/5 on TripAdvisor ("White Desert Adventure", Bawiti): https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g303850-d32977405-Reviews-White_Desert_Adventure-Bawiti_Giza_Governorate.html

## About the operator
- About us: https://explorewhitedesert.github.io/about/ - family-run by Kimo Nasr, born in Bawiti; running trips since 2001; Ministry of Tourism licence 1542884; team of 9 Bedouin-origin guides with first-aid training.
- Reviews: https://explorewhitedesert.github.io/reviews/ - 5.0 from 12 TripAdvisor reviews
- Contact and booking: https://explorewhitedesert.github.io/contact/ - WhatsApp +20 127 822 0004, reply within minutes, payment after the trip, free cancellation
